pattern: One small dark round mark on pale ground grows into scattered dark blotches, then into a spotted versus plain coat.

members.distinction: Is there a dark patch or heavy letter on white, or a smooth gradient? Dark bold patches on white push up.
members.positive: dark heavy letters and dots on white or pale ground (PHP, Cheese, dots on a lighter, bird silhouettes)
members.negative: smooth gradients and soft edges, fur, dark-to-light shaded surfaces

members.distinction: Detects one small dark round dot on a lighter field.
members.positive: Hole in a pen, eye of a cockatoo, dot on manhole, puck, hole in flute.
members.negative: Not opened.

members.distinction: Detects dark patches scattered on a lighter ground.
members.positive: Dalmatian, setter, ladybug, snake skin, goose bill, Doberman, Rottweiler tan marks, mantis.
members.negative: Not opened.

members.distinction: Separates dark spots scattered on a pale coat or skin (positive) from one even colour, a smooth sheen or a fine mesh (negative).
members.positive: Spotted or ticked coats: Dalmatian, English setter, bluetick, Great Dane, snow leopard, hyena, German pointer, an ox.
members.negative: Plain warm-brown coat (Rhodesian ridgeback, vizsla, malinois, Chesapeake), spirals, mesh, foam, even-coloured leather.

pattern: Thin lines fanning from a centre split into three kinds of strand: hanging, curled, draped.

members.distinction: Thin straight lines against a contrasting field.
members.positive: Guitar strings, spokes, piano keys, wing feathers, leopard whiskers.
members.negative: Not read.

members.distinction: Thin lines fanning out from a centre, versus dense dark bristle with a centre.
members.positive: Bolo tie, daisy petals, fan feathers, wheel spokes, a dome from below.
members.negative: Dense bristles: daisy centre, echidna, porcupine, Pomeranian face, macaque.

members.distinction: Long loose strands hanging in thin lines against a body, versus smooth blunt skin folds with no strands.
members.positive: Long hanging hair fringes and thin crossing lines: colobus tail, Afghan ears, Bernese coat, and also clock hands.
members.negative: Smooth short coat on a wide blunt wrinkled head (boxer, bull mastiff, pug), and an elephant's wrinkled trunk. Keeps out folds and smooth skin.

members.distinction: Curled or wavy loops of strand, versus straight sleek smooth short coat.
members.positive: Spaniel and poodle ears and curls, chain links, rope knots, siamang fur.
members.negative: Sleek short coats and radiating spikes: Weimaraner, pug, Rhodesian ridgeback, starfish, spider, fan blades.

members.distinction: A long smooth drape falling in one piece, versus small hard compact parts.
members.positive: Gowns, cloaks, abaya, Afghan ear, long wig hair, lizard on a trunk.
members.negative: Small hard items: mouse, phone, iPod, bottle, comb, Boston bull face. Keeps out compact things.

members.distinction: Head with two upright pointed ears on a front face.
members.positive: Collie, Australian terrier, Groenendael, Eskimo dog, hyena, toy terrier.
members.negative: Not read with a sheet.

pattern: Regular straight ruled lines build many parallel straight strands in a bundle versus a pebbly surface.

members.distinction: Many parallel straight strands in a bundle, versus pebbly dimpled short surface.
members.positive: Brush bristles, paintbrush, broom, wig, komondor cords, pelican feather, sloth hair.
members.negative: Dimpled or stippled short surface: golf ball, koala fur, shield, beetle, doormat. Keeps out dimples.

members.distinction: Fine regular ridges and ribs wound around.
members.positive: Brain coral, ammonite, hose ribs, snake scales, baseball seams, typewriter bar.
members.negative: Not read.

pattern: Which overall tone fills the body: pale, warm, or dark, as a split of one coat colour.

members.distinction: White surface, versus blue sky and hard-edged man-made things.
members.positive: White poodle, Samoyed, Saluki, egg, vulture head, white blossom.
members.negative: Blue sky scenes: lighthouse, planetarium, alp, castle, radio telescope.

members.distinction: Pale cream face of a dog or sheep.
members.positive: Labrador, Saluki, whippet, dalmatian, bighorn, Great Pyrenees faces.
members.negative: Not read.

members.distinction: Saturated orange or yellow patch.
members.positive: Macaw, bell pepper, lemon, sarong, king penguin patch.
members.negative: Dog faces and screens, at very low strength (-.5).

members.distinction: Pale cream-white body, versus dark solid brown body.
members.positive: White or cream: polar bear, cockatoo, egret, pale Labrador, white poodle.
members.negative: Dark chocolate or orange solid colour: chocolate and black Labrador, orange fruit, ferret, beaver. Keeps out dark brown.

members.distinction: Pure white fluffy body, versus mid tan or brown body.
members.positive: Maltese, Samoyed, cockatoo, flamingo, spoonbill, a white airship.
members.negative: Tan, brown, grey-brown bodies: warthog, hare, meerkat, jackfruit, border terrier. Keeps out mid tan.

members.distinction: Warm orange or russet patch on a body, versus black or very dark body.
members.positive: Red-orange: proboscis monkey face, ladybug, goldfish, merganser head, fox-coloured dog.
members.negative: Black or very dark: black bear, black Affenpinscher, black pug, buffalo, otter. Keeps out black.

members.distinction: Smooth warm red-brown bare body, versus white-and-black high contrast pattern.
members.positive: Redbone, ridgeback, Irish setter, sorrel horse, bare skin in bikini photos, unicycle leg.
members.negative: White and black pattern: polar bear, husky, malamute, clock, toucan, dumbbell, snow scenes.

pattern: Narrow tapered face versus flat short face, built from a smooth narrow face without a ruff.

members.distinction: Not read: its sheet was made, not opened.
members.positive: Not read.
members.negative: Not read.

members.distinction: Smooth narrow front face with a dark nose, versus fluffy-ruffed face.
members.positive: Dingo, toy terrier, red wolf, whippet, Doberman, Great Pyrenees front face.
members.negative: Ruffed faces: collie, papillon, Pomeranian, Eskimo dog, gibbon.

members.distinction: Long narrow tapered muzzle, versus flat short squashed face.
members.positive: Wolf, red wolf, dhole, borzoi, Italian greyhound, whippet, dingo, grizzly.
members.negative: Flat short faces: Boston bull, pug, Shih-Tzu, Pekinese, Japanese spaniel, Angora, hamster.

pattern: Long lean legged body versus low round bulky or heavily furred body; the head version splits pointed from round.

members.distinction: Detects a small pale blob on a darker area, near a dark edge.
members.positive: White paws, ping-pong ball, pale muzzle, dalmatian spot, candle flame, white feet of dogs.
members.negative: Not opened.

members.distinction: Detects four-legged body seen from the side on a ground.
members.positive: Dogs on lawn: Leonberg, Rottweiler, collie, wild boar, bear, dingo, rat, dowitchers with legs in view.
members.negative: Not opened.

members.distinction: Detects a pointed-ear head with tan muzzle facing the camera.
members.positive: Dingo, cairn, red fox, dhole, red wolf, gazelle, impala, basset, beagle, lesser panda.
members.negative: Not opened.

members.distinction: Separates a long, lean, tall-legged body (positive) from a low, round, bulky or heavily furred body (negative).
members.positive: Slender canids and lean animals, legs often in frame: borzoi, saluki, wolves, coyote, malamute, llama; short or smooth coat showing the legs.
members.negative: Stout round bodies: water buffalo, marmot, wombat, hippo, boxer, fluffy small dogs (Yorkie, Maltese, Shih-Tzu), plus violin, flute (thin things held to a face).

members.distinction: Separates a broad, round, frontal head with ears or a big rounded furry mass (positive) from thin, narrow, pointed shapes (negative).
members.positive: Faces and heads of furry or big animals looking at the camera: cow, Rottweiler, snow leopard, retrievers, tabby, lynx, Newfoundland, elephant.
members.negative: Narrow pointed forms: toy terrier, Ibizan hound, storks, oystercatcher, turnstone, beaver, porcupine nose, wallaby face; also climber. Birds with a spike bill.

pattern: A smooth plain field (sky, water, slope, colour patch) fills the frame beside or behind the subject, versus fine texture or close detail.

members.distinction: Dark thin hard edge on bright ground (bars, letters, grille).
members.positive: Grilles, prison bars, lettering, street signs, window frames.
members.negative: Round or curved saturated colour (lemons, banana, maraca, wheel).

members.distinction: Detects a plain smooth sky or ground with the edge of an object at the side.
members.positive: Tops of towers, mountains, crane, mast, a dog head cut off at the corner on a blue sky.
members.negative: Not opened.

members.distinction: Detects a saturated pink or bright colour patch.
members.positive: Pink umbrella, jellyfish, lotion, handkerchief, picks, parachute, patterned skirt.
members.negative: Not opened.

members.distinction: Water or sky surface around the subject, against fine banded land animals.
members.positive: Underwater views, swimmers, sharks, whales, submarine, seashore: subject in water.
members.negative: Zebra, hourglass, fox, poodle, tree frog, viper: fine banded or furred land things.

members.distinction: Separates a small or isolated figure against a contrasting ground (positive) from a flat close-up surface filling the frame (negative).
members.positive: Animals and objects set apart: ferret, indigo bunting, partridge, hares, badger, snowmobile, abacus, planetarium.
members.negative: Exactly s4:255's top photos: smooth plastic, cloth, scale, whistle, towel with watermarks.

members.distinction: one smooth convex arc or dome, against small round dials with radial hands
members.positive: domes and arcs: fireboat water arcs, radio dish, planetarium, armadillo shell, iron, fountain, mountain tent
members.negative: round dials with spokes and hands: analog and wall clocks, cart wheel, brass plaque, dippers and ouzels with white breast

members.distinction: Smooth far-away slope or ridge edge filling the frame, against small glossy near objects.
members.positive: Distant hills, volcano cones, valley walls and snow slopes: one big smooth diagonal ridge.
members.negative: Small glossy hand-sized things with round or whistle shapes (toys, balls, whistles, dials) and furry faces.

pattern: Hard printed marks on a flat surface versus a soft furry or limbed body.

members.distinction: Detects printed letters, digits and marks on a surface.
members.positive: Text and logos on laptop, phone, odometer, book jacket, helmet, digital clock.
members.negative: Not opened.

members.distinction: Separates a flat, smooth, near-uniform surface filling the frame (positive) from a body with thin limbs sticking out of a compact core (negative).
members.positive: Close-ups of smooth plastic, cloth, metal or a product face, no limbs, often a shop watermark across the photo; whistles, sleeping bag, towel, scale, safe.
members.negative: Bodies with outlines and appendages on a ground: harvestmen, spiders, beetles, ticks, and dogs (Boston bull, schnauzer, kuvasz, beagle). Dogs sit with the leggy bugs, not with cats.

members.distinction: Separates a bright, clean shape on a contrasting ground (positive) from a brown mottled mid-tone mass (negative).
members.positive: Glowing digits and dials on dark, and clean white or pale dogs on coloured ground: digital clock, scale, stopwatch, kuvasz, Eskimo dog, Arctic fox, grey parrot.
members.negative: Brown mottled things: wood rabbit, dung beetle, limpkin, Airedale, grouse, dingo, bighorn, frog.

pattern: At stage 3 several channels differ in what they let through, but they share a furry eyed face on the negative side.

members.distinction: a smooth blank surface or soft blur against a furry face with eyes
members.positive: plain wall, painted car side, bib, perfume bottle, blurred feathers: low-texture areas; also two dog close-ups with grey fur
members.negative: frontal dog faces and a gibbon face; keeps out furry eyed faces

members.distinction: a single tall or sky-backed structure against a furry eyed face
members.positive: towers, lighthouses, chimneys, airship, umbrella on open sky; also two dog photos
members.negative: dog faces plus one fox face and one human face; keeps out faces

members.distinction: a hand-made object on a plain ground against a furry face
members.positive: watch, laptop, kayak, rifle, hand blower: small man-made objects, weak firing (peak 2.1)
members.negative: dog faces (z -1.8) and a corn cob, a perforated board

members.distinction: a repeated small pattern (scales, dots, keys, bands) against a furry face
members.positive: snake skin, accordion keys, ladybug, spider, keypad: regular repeated marks
members.negative: dog and monkey faces (z -5.1, deepest of the set); keeps out faces

members.distinction: a round wheel set in a long smooth painted body (side view of a vehicle) against a soft centered face or radial bloom with a dark nose or eye-like middle
members.positive: side views of vans, fire engines, cabs, a go-kart: wheel plus flat body panel; top 16 are all vehicles with a visible wheel
members.negative: human and dog faces (nose, mouth), daisies and other flowers with a round centre; keeps out faces and radial organic shapes

members.distinction: soft organic bloom or fur patch (radial or furry mass) against the man-made channels' side
members.positive: dog nose, gibbon, thistle, daisy, sunflower pictures, pelican bill: furry or petal mass, not cars
members.negative: not looked at

members.distinction: a smooth round rim or disc on a flat glossy surface
members.positive: wheels of vans, rims of cups, bottle necks, joystick: round smooth edge on plain surface
members.negative: not looked at

members.distinction: a small round or lettered mark on a smooth ground against fine irregular fur or mesh
members.positive: hub caps, letters, dials, eyes of birds: small bold mark on smooth ground
members.negative: fur, chainlink fence, honeycomb, hair, moss: dense fine irregular texture; keeps out fine texture

pattern: A thin or spreading shape on bare ground versus round smooth closed shapes.

members.distinction: Detects long thin edges lying across a plain ground, like feathers, spokes or ties.
members.positive: Wing feathers, cart wheel, bow tie, pineapple scales, tail, knife blade.
members.negative: Not opened.

members.distinction: Warm dark silhouette shapes with sharp steps against a glow.
members.positive: Staircase, throne bust, pier railing, drilling platform at dusk, honeycomb.
members.negative: Not read.

members.distinction: A jet or plume spreading out from a point, against round smooth closed shapes.
members.positive: Geyser plumes, fountains, wave splash, steam, fire-boat jets, killer whale spray: a V or fan of white.
members.negative: Round smooth closed things: car wheel hub, pill bottles, bubble, nipple, carousel, ostrich head.

members.distinction: Separates thin strands or bars crossing a plain ground, including long shaggy hair (positive), from smooth, sleek, closed surfaces (negative).
members.positive: Shaggy coats and thin frames: komondor, Lhasa, Bouvier, Old English sheepdog, rickshaw wheels, chair legs, wheelbarrow, warplane gear, shopping cart.
members.negative: Smooth sleek bodies: whippet, gazelle, impala, miniature pinscher, Doberman, borzoi, egret, balloon-like shapes (soccer ball, perfume bottle, bikini).

members.distinction: Separates a huge, smooth, thick-skinned body (positive) from fine wiry hair and small thin parts (negative).
members.positive: Grey whale, elephant (tusker), turtle, hippo, bison: dark wet hide, tails, big heads half out of water.
members.negative: Wiry or fine-detail things: standard schnauzer, Dandie Dinmont, affenpinscher, gallinule, vulture, keyboard, reel, beetles.

pattern: A narrow or vivid object enters from the edge of a smooth empty field; one smooth sweep versus dense small parts.

members.distinction: a smooth empty field with a thin edge object entering at its border
members.positive: plain blue sky or plain background, with a pole, wire, shaker or hull entering at an edge
members.negative: not read

members.distinction: a narrow shape that tapers into a pale or open region at the edge of the view
members.positive: dog snouts at the frame edge, flute, bridge arches, tower, camera barrel, scooter handle, croquet hoop
members.negative: not read

members.distinction: a vivid saturated colour patch that differs strongly from the colours around it
members.positive: purple, magenta, yellow and blue patches: toy, bottle, pretzel, anemone, parrot, mask
members.negative: not read (neg sheet not looked at)

members.distinction: one smooth, glossy, streamlined surface that sweeps in a single curve, against dense warm brown or red surfaces that are full of small parts
members.positive: smooth glossy bodies with one long curve: car bonnets, boat hulls, jet fuselage, shark and gator skin, plain white duvet. Blue-grey and white dominate
members.negative: warm brown/red/tan close-ups with rounded edges and detail (barn, red pan, cello, baseball, mortar, trilobite, isopod). Keeps out textured, small-part things

members.distinction: a narrow metal tube with small round loops, keys or guards on it held close up, against large smooth round enclosures and legged forms
members.positive: revolver and rifle barrel with trigger guard, oboe and flute keys, harmonica, ballpoint, trombone, poodle and guenon muzzle
members.negative: large round smooth enclosures and spidery forms: clock, steel drum, ladle, vault, potter wheel, tarantula, bird heads

pattern: Small round blobs, alone or packed, build a dense clump of round bumps.

members.distinction: a small round saturated blob sitting on a contrasting ground
members.positive: berries, tomatoes, red dots on a joystick, balls, ladybug, strawberry on cream
members.negative: not read

members.distinction: a cluster of small round or oval bumps packed together
members.positive: olives, peas, lemons in a bowl, daisy centre, brain coral, knotted rope, pom-poms
members.negative: not read

members.distinction: a dense clump of small round bumps, in green, against warm thin-limbed forms on plain ground
members.positive: broccoli and other green clumped fractal masses; also tree-covered hills and a dome among trees
members.negative: warm brown/tan thin-limbed bodies on plain ground, rows of roasted birds, red-brown fur (impala, bighorn, fox, rotisserie)

pattern: A narrow tapered or pointed shape (tip, ears, rigging) versus soft furry or closed shapes.

members.distinction: thin dark straight lines that cross at an angle over a pale, bright ground
members.positive: bare twigs on sky, wires, music stand, chrome rim, panel edges, car roof edge, pan rim
members.negative: not read (stage 2 here: crops are tiny)

members.distinction: a narrow tip or neck that tapers up from a wider body, standing upright
members.positive: bottle necks, spires, shaker caps, baby bottle teats, stupa, bell tower tops
members.negative: not read

members.distinction: rigid straight lines meeting at an angle to make a triangular frame, against soft furry shapes with small pointed ears
members.positive: taut lines and A-frames: sailboat rigging, suspension bridge cables, tent edge, tripod, harp strings, mosquito net, pelican bill
members.negative: soft fur with small pointed ears: coyote, tabby, fox squirrel, Siamese cat, rabbit, brown bear, miniature pinscher

members.distinction: thin straight parallel stripes of strong contrast
members.positive: zebra, picket fence, typewriter keys, clock hand, stripes on a sleeve, safety pin
members.negative: not read

members.distinction: a pointed pair of ears over a narrow muzzle, facing the viewer
members.positive: dog, fox, wolf, collie faces; a Polaroid camera front
members.negative: not read

members.distinction: a thin pointed shape swept out against open sky or empty ground, against closed loops, grids and dark enclosed forms
members.positive: wing-spread planes and storks against sky, pen nib, snake head, hammerhead, bustard
members.negative: enclosed loops, grids and mesh: padlock shackle, waffle iron, gas mask, syringe, spatula, beetle, snowmobile

pattern: Long straight thin edges across plain ground build a criss-cross lattice.

members.distinction: Detects long straight edges with plain ground on both sides.
members.positive: Tower, mast, church spire, modem edge, jersey edge, dog's muzzle in side view.
members.negative: Not opened.

members.distinction: Detects a regular criss-cross lattice of thin lines laid across the scene.
members.positive: Chain-link fence, in front of animals (cougar, wallaby, gibbon, squirrel monkey), padlock and chain.
members.negative: Not opened.

pattern: Rows of small hard parallel parts versus thin spokes or wings on open ground.

members.distinction: A body edge against flat bright ground.
members.positive: Cuirass straps, bird tail on sky, dog on grass, bottles on white.
members.negative: Not read.

members.distinction: Small hard-edged dark-and-light hardware detail.
members.positive: Locomotive window band, telephone dial, padlock, tandem frame, photocopier panel.
members.negative: Not read.

members.distinction: Rounded curved warm brown or metal body parts in close crop.
members.positive: Trombone, throne post, bull mastiff legs, brass finial, weasel fur.
members.negative: Not read.

members.distinction: Warm saturated orange-red glossy surface.
members.positive: Fig, stew, agaric, crab, egg yolk, car window glare.
members.negative: Not read.

members.distinction: Long row of parallel straight bars, against thin spokes or wings on open background.
members.positive: Train sides and rails, piano keys, steel-drum rims, spoon rows: repeated parallel horizontal bands.
members.negative: Bicycle wheels and riders, warplanes in formation, soaring birds, crab legs, ladybug: thin diagonal spokes, wings, legs.
